title: Malampaya Batangas plant marks 25 years of zero accident

blocks.text: The Malampaya Onshore Gas Plant in Batangas City has marked 25 years of zero accident in a display of commitment to safe operations. The plant has maintained its Goal Zero record since Sept. 28, 2001 through key maintenance works that support the Malampaya Deep Water Gas to Power project. Goal Zero is part of the commitment of Prime Energy, which leads the Malampaya consortium, to the safety of employees, contractors and the environment. “Reaching 25 years of Goal Zero is a significant operational achievement, particularly for a facility that has supported continuous gas production, major maintenance activities, and increasingly complex operations […]...
